def get_max_sum (n):
	res = list()
	res.append(0)
	res.append(1)
	i = 2
	while i<n + 1:
		res.append(max(i, (res[int(i / 2)] 
						+ res[int(i / 3)] +
							res[int(i / 4)]
						+ res[int(i / 5)])))
		i = i + 1
	return res[n]

import re
def is_valid_URL(str):
	regex = ("((http|https)://)(www.)?" +
			"[a-zA-Z0-9@:%._\\+~#?&//=]" +
			"{2,256}\\.[a-z]" +
			"{2,6}\\b([-a-zA-Z0-9@:%" +
			"._\\+~#?&//=]*)")
	p = re.compile(regex)
	if (str == None):
		return False
	if(re.search(p, str)):
		return True
	else:
		return False
